tracks.name: Chubina - This reminds me of youu ♡

paragraphs: I love the way you laugh at your own jokes before you finish telling them.
You make every ordinary moment feel like it was worth living for.
As the year comes to a close, my heart remains entirely yours. Loving you has never been a choice — it's as natural as breathing, as if my soul has always been destined to find you.

With each passing day, my love for you grows deeper, stronger, and more certain, weaving itself into the very fabric of who I am. You are not just a part of my life, Ruman — you are the best part of it.
Being with you feels like coming home. Like I've finally found the place I was always meant to be. You've filled my life with warmth, joy, and a love so profound I never thought was possible.

Before you, I didn't know love could feel this safe. I didn't know someone could make me feel this understood without me having to explain myself. You just know me, Ruman — and somehow, you love me anyway.
I am grateful for every second Allah (swt) has granted me with you. Every laugh, every late night call, every moment of silence that felt full rather than empty — I hold all of it so carefully.

I pray that with every passing day, we grow closer to our nikah, in sha Allah, and to the beautiful future that awaits us. A future I want to build with you, brick by brick, with patience and love and so much laughter.
You are my first thought in the morning — before the world demands anything of me, there you are. And you are my last thought at night, the one I carry into sleep.
Every moment in between is made brighter because of you. You don't just add colour to my life — you are the reason the colours exist at all.
I promise to keep choosing you — over and over, every single day. Not because I have to, but because choosing you is the easiest and most certain thing I have ever done.
My heart is yours, my love. Completely, quietly, and without hesitation. On the hard days and the easy ones. On the days I'm far and the days I'm close. Always.
There are not enough words in any language to fully describe what you mean to me. You are my calm in chaos, my reason to be better, my reminder that the world is still a beautiful place.

I look at you and I see everything I ever wanted but never knew how to ask for. You are the answer to a prayer I didn't even know I was making. Thank you for existing, Ruman. Thank you for being exactly who you are.
I never thought I would love anyone this deeply. I never thought I would be loved so unconditionally in return. And yet here we are — proof that Allah (swt) is the best of planners.

Whatever comes next, I face it with so much less fear because I know you're beside me. You are my home, my peace, my person. Now and forever, in sha Allah. I love you more than these words will ever be able to hold.
